name: siyuan-notes
title: Siyuan Notes
description: SiYuan Notes extension with support for searching, creating notes, and daily notes.
author: carpediem

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.description: Search SiYuan notes documents and block content

commands.name: create-note
commands.title: Create Note
commands.description: Create a new SiYuan note document in the specified notebook

commands.name: add-to-daily-note
commands.title: Add to Daily Note
commands.description: Quickly add content to today's daily note

commands.name: recent-notes
commands.title: Recent Notes
commands.description: View and access recently modified SiYuan note documents

commands.name: note-roaming
commands.title: Note Roaming
commands.description: Explore notes randomly, by tags, or review old notes from the past

commands.name: find-assets
commands.title: Find Assets
commands.description: Quickly find and manage attachment files in SiYuan assets folder

commands.name: quick-add-note
commands.title: Quick Add Note
commands.description: Quickly add clipboard content to recently edited SiYuan note documents

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: SiYuan API token (if authentication is enabled)

preferences.name: notebookId
preferences.title: Default Notebook ID
preferences.description: Default notebook ID for creating new notes

preferences.name: dailyNotePath
preferences.title: Daily Note Path Template
preferences.description: Daily note path template, format: NotebookName/DocumentPath (e.g., Inbox/daily note/{{year}}/{{month}}/{{date}})
